title: ad-hoc-field-claims-and-owner-clipboard-aug-2030
content:
Purpose: one-page ad-hoc tracker to capture small, uncategorized coverage asks and who is owning the short follow-ups. Lightweight — meant to be copied into a handoff email or sprint day-of notes.

Notes about format: rows are intentionally terse. Use initials in Owner column if you want (we maintain full list below). Status values: pending / in_progress / blocked / closed. Priority buckets: P0 (urgent day-of), P1 (next 3 days), P2 (sometime this sprint).

TABLE
ID | Short description | Owner | Priority | Est effort | Status | Last touch | Quick notes / links
-- | ----------------- | ----- | -------- | ---------- | ------ | ---------- | ------------------
1  | Regional fallback test for eu-west-2 after db migration | Rafael Ortiz | P0 | 2h | in_progress | 2030-08-11 | Rafael validated traffic cutoff; need runbook step for emergency rollback. See slack thread above.
2  | Confirm Dedicated pool quota for SE pilot (Q3) | Priya Desai | P1 | 1d | pending | 2030-08-08 | Finance asked for cost cap; assigned to Priya to confirm commitment terms. Linked: JIRA-OPS-4821.
3  | Quick sampling of token-level billing mismatch (small subset) | Maya Chen | P1 | 4h | in_progress | 2030-08-12 | Sampling script in GH gist; results to be pasted in ops-digest.
4  | Surface-level sensitivity scan for new private deploy config | Ethan Walker | P2 | 1d | blocked | 2030-08-09 | Waiting on security key access from infra (ticket open).
5  | Ad-hoc on-call handoff template updates (weekend) | Maya Chen | P0 | 1h | closed | 2030-08-02 | Published to confluence, notified rotations.
6  | Small UX ask: add short model label to console route card | Priya Desai | P2 | 3h | pending | 2030-08-01 | Product signoff pending — small front-end change.
7  | One-off customer SLA exception approval (Acct: Hummingbird) | Rafael Ortiz | P0 | 30m | in_progress | 2030-08-10 | Legal looped in; need signature from Head of Sales.
8  | Local infra node health sweep in us-west-1 (mini) | SRE-rotation | P1 | 2h | pending | 2030-07-31 | Quick check — could be batched with #1.
9  | Validate model-variant fallback mapping for low-memory nodes | Ethan Walker | P1 | 6h | pending | 2030-08-07 | Cross-check with runtime mapping table (internal repo).
10 | Temporary logging retention increase for debug window | Maya Chen | P0 | 1h | closed | 2030-08-03 | Raised and then reverted after debug; cost delta logged.

Owner directory (quick reference):
- Maya Chen — ops (owner of this tracker)
- Rafael Ortiz — site-reliability / launches
- Priya Desai — product ops / pricing & commitments
- Ethan Walker — infra / private deploys
- SRE-rotation — whoever is on rotation for given week (call out in last touch)

Quick snapshot metrics (manual tally from rows above):
- Total open rows: 6 (IDs 1,2,3,4,6,9,7 included? actually #7 is in_progress so open. Count = 7)
- P0 items: 4 (IDs 1,5,7,10) — two closed (#5,#10) => active P0s: 2
- Blocked: 1 (ID 4)
- Average est effort remaining (open items): ~3 hours (very rough)

One-off analysis notes (mini):
- Billing mismatch sampling: early signs point to a prefix-caching gap for long-lived sessions. If sample holds, next step = toggle cache TTL and re-run sample on low-traffic window.
- Dedicated pool quota ask: finance is concerned about burst charges. Recommend locking minimum commit + burst buffer in writing; Priya to propose commit band to Sales.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Who signs the SLA exception for Hummingbird? (needs Head of Sales + Legal) — Rafael to escalate to Priya if no reply by 08/13.
- Priority for adding model label to console route card: product to decide by EOD 08/14 or move to backlog.
- Security key for Ethan: infra to confirm ETA on KMS grant; if >48h, propose temporary scoped key for scan.

Actions (short checklist):
- [ ] Rafael: draft rollback step for eu-west-2 fallback test and attach to runbook (due 2030-08-13)
- [ ] Priya: confirm Dedicated quota commit proposal and send to finance (due 2030-08-14)
- [x] Maya: publish weekend on-call handoff template (done 2030-08-02)
- [ ] Ethan: follow up infra KMS ticket, update status in this sheet (due 2030-08-14)
- [ ] Ops rotation: do mini health sweep and report within 4h when scheduled

Context snippets / tiny provenance log (useful for handoff):
- Created as quick clipboard during cross-functional sync on 2030-08-01.
- Pulled in items from slack:/launch-coordination, JIRA-OPS-4821, and the model-routing quickmap PR (#897 in internal GH).

How to use: copy the relevant rows into a sprint day-of email or paste into the weekly ops standup doc. Keep this file small and ephemeral; archive completed rows monthly (move to confluence summary).

Past versions: none (this was made to be ephemeral). If this becomes long-lived we should template into an OpsBoard widget.

References: short links above. For detailed tickets see linked_artifacts.

End of tracker (Maya Chen, ops)
